info.title: LMS Analytics Service
info.description: Read-only dashboards and scheduled reports built from every other service's events (docs/PRODUCT.md §5.9): institution and platform-wide learning, exam-integrity, support, hiring and AI-usage/billing dashboards, all traceable to the events that produced them. PostgreSQL, not ClickHouse (D12) — see the README.

scheduled report references one, plus the filters it is run with.
